Includes setting out the line, excavating in layers under continuous watch, stockpiling the material alongside the trench, trimming the bottom to the required fall and keeping the trench signed while it remains open. It does not include cartage of the surplus material to a spoil site, which is priced in the earthworks haulage subsection. Measured by the theoretical volume of excavation to the design dimensions.
